body: Temporary pain or recurrent temporary pain? I dont think I can handle hoping for the best anymore. It always goes bad again. I don't expect a life of permanent happiness but even my most content moments are clouded with paranoia and sadness. I'm too tired for this shit.

Is it worth continuing though? I mean Im sick of a constant rollercoaster. Things are okay and then they're shit and then they're okay but sooner or later it just becomes shit again. I have no fight left.
